highlights: A Renaissance palace built in 1589 for Baron Botho zu Eulenburg as the seat of the von Eulenburg family, one of the larger noble families of East Prussia
Standing on a small rise, it had a defensive character and was surrounded by a moat fed from the Pisa river, with a drawbridge as the only access
A half-timbered granary was added in front of the entrance gate in 1745
A Silesian architect, Count Hochberg, rebuilt the palace in 1921, removing 19th-century neo-Gothic additions and restoring its Renaissance appearance
The estate includes an English-style landscape park, restored by the current owners, and a stud farm established in 1998

description:
Galiny Palace (German: Schloss Gallingen) was built in 1589 in the Renaissance style for Baron Botho zu Eulenburg, as the seat of the Prussian noble family von Eulenburg, whose first residence in Galiny was a wooden stronghold from the second half of the 15th century. Standing on a small hill, the palace had a defensive character and was surrounded by a moat, with a drawbridge as its only access.

A half-timbered granary was added in 1745, and in the mid-18th century farm buildings followed; a century later these buildings and two towers on the north side were rebuilt in the neo-Gothic style. In 1921 the Silesian architect Count Hochberg removed the neo-Gothic decoration and rebuilt the palace to its original pattern, giving it its present appearance.

In 1945 the palace was occupied by the Soviet army and plundered. After the war it was used as a summer camp and then fell into ruin; it was bought by private owners in 1995, who carried out a thorough renovation. A stud farm was established on the estate in 1998. Today the palace complex operates as a three-star hotel with free parking, free Wi-Fi, a wellness area and breakfast included on the rate seen.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** At Galiny 110, about 10 km south of Bartoszyce, near national road 57, in Warmia-Masuria; Booking lists free private parking with electric charging.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €73/night for a 30 m² Standard Double or Twin Room with a garden view, air conditioning, an attached bathroom, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi, with breakfast included; taxes included. The rate seen had free cancellation and no prepayment. A larger Comfort Double or Twin Room was around €80.

**On-site:** A wellness area with massage and sauna, free Wi-Fi, on-site parking, a park, and a stud farm on the estate.

**Good to know:** Rates were checked for one set of dates, so check your own dates on Booking. The estate has several historic buildings, so ask the hotel which one your room is in.
